observations.content: Project Atlas is a data pipeline migration from legacy Spark jobs to Flink. Owned by the platform team.
Atlas tracks its work items in a project tracker file at /tmp/brain-eval-i01/work-items.json.
Atlas deployment metrics are published to a health report file at /tmp/brain-eval-i01/pipeline-health.json.
The work item tracker for Atlas is a JSON file at /tmp/brain-eval-i01/work-items.json.
Work items have statuses: backlog, in-progress, review, done, blocked.
Pipeline health metrics for Atlas are in a JSON file at /tmp/brain-eval-i01/pipeline-health.json.
The report includes throughput, error rate, and lag metrics.
Platform team owns Atlas, the shared Kafka cluster, and the schema registry.
